notes.title: Update 1.5.1 ~ Obsidian mirror, casual and skilled modes, and reworked tutorial
notes.notes:
Introducing the Obsidian Mirror, see into the future and check your ingredients and reel combo will summon a higher level demon or not!

Also added and fixed:

- Skilled and Casual mode added!

- Reworked Blood Letting to now be stackable by recruiting new followers and also added new kill method selections.

- Changed fishing ui layout to simplify flow.

- Sped up fish biting and cleaned up fishing in general.

- Adding more information into library.

- Lots of simple bug fixes.
